profile.headline: Productionizing AI inside the Salesforce platform | Senior Engineer  @ Boston Beer Company | Apex · Python · MCP · AI engineering
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer at Boston Beer Company, working at the intersection of the Salesforce platform and applied AI engineering.
I'm on our Business Applications team and support Sales Strategy & Enablement team, building and supporting the Salesforce platform behind Consumer Goods Cloud, wholesaler programs, and the field tools our brewery reps use every day. Alongside that, I've been focused on bringing AI engineering into how we build and ship: rolling out Claude Code across the team, standing up an MCP server monorepo that connects Salesforce code and production telemetry to AI agents, and helping shape the roadmap for AI in sales enablement at BBC.
Where I'm growing: cross-platform AI/ML engineering across Salesforce, Azure, and Databricks. I spend a lot of time in LLM engineering and ML fundamentals, with a bias toward the applied side — what actually ships and holds up in production.
I came to software later than most. After a career in the Army, I transitioned into engineering in my 40s, self-taught, starting with Apex and LWC and growing out from there. Cal Newport's So Good They Can't Ignore You shaped how I think about skill development — deliberate, patient, compounding.
Currently: building MCP servers, prototyping an internal industry intelligence system using agentic RAG, shipping observability for sales-facing Apex, and getting fluent in Python data science. Always happy to compare notes with people working on similar problems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Salesforce engineering for Sales Strategy & Enablement — Consumer Goods Cloud field-sales platform and wholesaler programs used daily by brewery field reps and sales leadership.

• Rolled out Claude Code and AI-assisted development workflows across the team; packaged an internal augmented-engineering plugin so shipping patterns, hooks, and skills propagate to the team instead of living in individual dev setups.

• Developing Industry Intelligence RAG system. 

• Built and operate an MCP server monorepo on Azure DevOps (Apex Code Intelligence, Salesforce CLI, Nebula Logger) — exposing Salesforce code and production telemetry to AI agents for faster diagnosis, code review, and cross-platform automation.

• Represent the team in cross-functional AI forums — internal AI Club demos, quarterly AI/ML readouts to leadership, and shaping the roadmap for AI-enabled sales enablement at Boston Beer Company.

• Shipped a production observability system on Nebula Logger — governor-limit monitoring, CPU/SOQL/heap alerting, and MCP-queryable hotspot dashboards across sales-facing Apex.

• Built an automated rollback pipeline and selective-test execution into CI/CD, turning Salesforce production deploys from one-way doors into reversible operations.

• Delivered Power BI Embedded inside the Salesforce Account Overview page (LWC → Visualforce → Azure AD OAuth → Power BI RLS), putting account-level analytics in-context for reps without tool-switching.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Prompt Engineering · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Claude Skills

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer / Salesforce
positions.description: Lead engineer on the Customer Experience Technology team

positions.title: Lead Developer - Salesforce
positions.description:
Lead developer on a team of 5. 

Worked with FFLIB frame work.

positions.title: Senior Salesforce  Developer
positions.description:
Enhanced customer support by replacing 6 JavaScript buttons with a single page application using Lighting Web Components and Lighting Out to interface with Okta APIs.

Trained internal developers on security best practices and developed a managed package to implement AES256 Encryption

Developed REST APIs to integrate Client Salesforce data with an external Identity Provider as part of a single sign on project

Created algorithm to evaluate community users in thirty-three possible scenarios for use with a 3rd party website

Developed framework to centralize all queueable apex to eliminate record locking issues in production

Developed centralized error handling and logging framework

Lead Implementation of Git and version control.

Led implementation of version control and dev-ops process in an organization where most developers were working in the Developer Console with no version control. 

Trained developers on Git, Jest Testing, and TDD fundamentals

Implemented code quality standards and use of static code analysis

Reduced time needed for font-end development by creating re-usable LWC’s with Slots. A design system based on CSS grid and reusable router for LWC Single Page Applications

positions.title: Salesforce Developer / Consultant
positions.description:
Developed custom REST APIs in Salesforce 
Repaced legacy functionality with Lighting Web Components
Create an encryption package to share data securely
Trained teams on Git and version control
Trained teams on code standards in Apex
Lead Developer on project to enhance Lighting Aura Components in custom Salesforce Community

positions.title: Salesforce Developer and Consultant
positions.description:
Responsible for all aspects of technical design and implementation for multiple Salesforce consulting engagements, with clients ranging from Fortune 50 to Medium sized businesses.  Mentoring two junior administrators.  Supporting businesses with marketing, sales and service support, and expertise. 

MAJOR ACHIEVEMENTS
+	Developed a custom application using both declarative and programmatic tools to track the effectiveness of influencer marketing campaigns 
+	Provided training to admins on the use of tools such as Declarative Roll-Up Summary to enhance their Salesforce Orgs with clicks instead of code  
+	Created custom reports with Visual Force
+	Developed declarative features to automate business processes. Such as approval processes, renewal opportunities or flagging contacts that meet certain criteria 
+	Develop asynchronous Apex code to allow for large data operations
+	Develop custom reports and dashboards
+	Implemented forecasting and territory management for clients
+	Develop Apex unit tests for declarative tools and programmatic development
+      Lead Org migration to SFDX and package based development
+      Develop Visualforce and Lightning Web Components

positions.title: Manager Sales Operations / Saleforce Administrator
positions.description:
Director of Sales and Sales Operations 								July 2016 – Present
Responsible for the overall strategy and success of marketing and recruitment efforts in three states. Currently expanding operations into five more based on early success.   Provided data-driven solutions to an organization traditionally run by feel.   Reported to and advised SVP and COO on process redesign.  Projects included developing and designing tools to measure and report on KPIs. Regression models to forecast market size and forecasting models.  

Developed new ARIMA forecast models using R programming language.

honors.description: Chosen to present on the use of Linux, Schell Scripting and the Salesforce CLI at the North East Dreamin Salesforce Conference.

honors.title: Salesforce Curriculum Designer
honors.description: Assisted in the development of undergraduate CRM / Salesforce course at Suffolk University in Boston.
